fields.hint: Original value is the lower of purchase price and appraisal. Blank assumes appraisal is at least the price.

implemented_modes.description: Use your own annual borrower-paid PMI rate and compare the two cancellation paths without estimating an insurer rate.
implemented_modes.formula: Monthly quoted PMI = original principal × annual PMI percentage / 100 / 12. Premium timing follows the stated cancellation scenario.

implemented_modes.title: Cancellation & LTV

fields.label: 80% request conditions
options: Confirmed: good history, no junior liens, value not declined

implemented_modes.description: Check an existing loan against original-value 80%, scheduled 78% and midpoint benchmarks; current market LTV is shown separately.
implemented_modes.formula: Request benchmark = earlier scheduled or actual 80% original-value date. Automatic benchmark = earlier original-schedule 78% date or month after the original term midpoint, if current.

title: Biweekly Mortgage Payment Calculator
source_status: Reference text and controls reviewed 2026-10-26; independently implemented model; reference numeric/visual parity unverified

implemented_modes.title: Biweekly vs Monthly
implemented_modes.description: Compare accelerated half-monthly payments every two weeks with standard monthly payments and a monthly plan using the same annual budget.
implemented_modes.formula: Monthly P&I = P × i / (1 − (1 + i)^−n). Biweekly payment = monthly / 2 + extra. Model rate = annual / 26; matched monthly budget = biweekly × 26 / 12.

title: Discount Points Calculator
source_status: Reference text and controls reviewed 2026-10-26; independently implemented model; reference numeric/visual parity unverified

implemented_modes.title: Compare Loan Quotes
implemented_modes.description: Compare actual rate/points quotes, cash-flow and balance-aware break-even, and savings at your expected sale or refinance date.
implemented_modes.formula: Point cost = principal × points / 100. Net horizon saving B = cumulative interest A − cumulative interest B − (upfront B − upfront A). Cash-flow saving excludes the balance advantage.
